title: Better Furniture-Neoforge
description: Unofficial Port of Better Furniture to Neoforge
body:
This is an unofficial Neoforge port of Better Furniture. Most features from the original mod are preserved, with adjustments for compatibility on the Neoforge platform.

Adds simple, vanilla-like furniture to the game, including tables, chairs and stools. You can also sit on the 'lap' of an already seated player.

Original project:
https://modrinth.com/mod/better-furniture
